data:
diff --git a/.github/workflows/pages.yml b/.github/workflows/pages.yml
index 65d81384..93965f59 100644
--- a/.github/workflows/pages.yml
+++ b/.github/workflows/pages.yml
@@ -96,6 +96,21 @@ jobs:
           du -sk _site
           cat _site/packs/latest.json
 
+      - name: Bundle the client JS into one file
+        working-directory: ${{ github.workspace }}
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          npx --yes esbuild@0.25.0 _site/js/client/play.js --bundle --format=esm --splitting --outdir=_site/js/client --entry-names=play.bundle --chunk-names=chunk-[hash] --external:./pkg/* --external:./vendor/* --external:wireweave --external:wireweave/* --external:nostr-tools --external:xstate --external:node:*
+          du -sk _site/js/client/play.bundle.js
+          sed -i 's|<script type="module" src="play.js"></script>|<script type="module" src="play.bundle.js"></script>|' _site/js/client/play.html
+          grep -q 'src="play.bundle.js"' _site/js/client/play.html
+
+      - name: Bundle the moba Lua modules into one file
+        working-directory: ${{ github.workspace }}
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          node scripts/bundle-lua.mjs scenarios/moba _site/scenarios/moba/bundle/moba.modules.lua
+
       - uses: actions/upload-pages-artifact@v3
         with:
           path: _site
